label: Predictive Maintenance (Member 3)
info:
Member 3 flow: validate telemetry, analytics (risk, state, fault cause, TTC), dashboard, maintenance loop.
Derived events are published to MQTT (/features, /health, /alerts, /actions); Member 2's bridge forwards them to Kafka.

name: 1. Ingest + validate telemetry (QoS 0)
info: Bad JSON, missing machine_id/timestamp or non-numeric sensors are quarantined (shown on the dashboard and in the debug sidebar), never processed.

name: Validate & quarantine
2. Analytics: EMA smoothing, 20-sample window, weighted risk + safety floor, state, fault cause, TTC (R2 >= 0.70)
Analytics engine
info: Outputs: 1 health · 2 features · 3 alert (state change) · 4 recommended action · 5-7 dashboard charts

name: alert → toast text
Chart setup (series order)
3. Status + Last Will (retained, QoS 1): ONLINE / OFFLINE per pump
Connectivity handler
4. Fleet dashboard (1 s refresh, ranked by priority) + closed-loop maintenance
Fleet snapshot + priority
